card.name: Open parenthesis before an acronym
card.fires_on: The open parenthesis right after a spelled-out name, where the acronym follows (often ending in P). Also fires on a few spots partway through capitalised words such as DIARRHEA.

modes.label: Parenthesis before acronym
modes.description: An opening bracket after a full name, just before its short form is given.
modes.example: They are the "North Ecliptic Pole" (NEP) and "South Ecliptic Pole"<< (>>SEP).

modes.label: Inside capitalised warning words
modes.description: Partway through an all-caps word in a boxed warning, such as DIARRHEA.
